text: GTA 6 has been out for three days, and the streamers are already breaking it. Today we've got a gas station that swallows cars, a furry on the run from the cops, a helicopter that picks the worst place to land, and IShowSpeed making the most painful mistake you can make in this game. Stay till the end for that one.
First up, Zoree. All he wanted was a quick stop for gas. Watch where the camera ends up.
How does that even happen? Rockstar, please check the gas pumps.
Same streamer, same day, brand new problem. Zoree is still learning the PlayStation controller, and a guy on a bike decides to get involved.
He did not move. The bike chose chaos. These NPCs have zero chill.
Now, a hot take. X Q C has an answer for anyone who says GTA 6 feels empty.
Harsh, but he has a point. Walk for twenty seconds in Vice City, and something weird will happen. Like this.
Lacy is driving at night when the police radio reports something nobody expected. Listen closely.
Free the fur. That fox was ready to go down fighting, and honestly, respect.
Next, Oh-nuh Pixel. He sets one simple goal for this drive. Remember his exact words.
Not his fault, apparently. Ten out of ten clean driving, if you squint.
Jerma is standing right next to a police helicopter. He has a plan. It is not a good plan.
Get in the water was the right call. He was just a few seconds too late.
And finally, the one I teased. IShowSpeed is ninety eight percent through the story, and he is naming his next save GTA 6 finale.
He wants to replay the ending, so he has to load an old save. Watch which one he picks.
That ninety eight percent save is gone forever. Subscribe to Shak Replay for new GTA 6 streamer moments every single day. Tomorrow we go even deeper into Vice City. See you there.
